logp.method_description: The octanol–water partition coefficients for compounds 1 and 2 were determined by a modification of the reported shake-flask method [83]. Water (50 ml, ultrapure) and n-octanol (50 ml) were shaken together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. A solution of the complex was prepared in the water phase (3 × 10-3 M) and an equal volume of octanol was added. Biphasic solutions were mixed for 10 min and then centrifuged for 5 min at 6000 rpm to allow separation. Concentration in both phases was determined by UV–Vis. Reported logP is defined as log([complex]oct/[complex]wat). Final values were reported as the mean of three determinations.
